source: Fomation_Platforme.shp (USGS I-270A 1:2M, attributes after Saudi Aramco 2016 chart)

ARB.name: Arab
ARB.members: Arab A, Arab B, Arab C, Arab D
ARB.lith: Limestone/calcarenite with anhydrite; salt in the east

ARM.name: Aruma
ARM.lith: Limestone with shale and minor sandstone tongues
ARM.remarks: Unconformity at base; member names partly from literature (redacted on the chart)

DHR.name: Dhruma
DHR.members: D7-D1 (T1/D7, D6-D5, D4-D3, Upper D2, Lower D2, D1)

DMM.name: Dammam

DMM.remarks: member names partly from literature (redacted on the chart)

HDR.name: Hadrukh

HDR.remarks: Pre-Neogene unconformity at base; member names partly from literature (redacted on the chart)

JAF.name: Jauf
JAF.lith: Shale with sandstone lenses; minor dolomite at top

MNJ.name: Minjur
